summary: Lane I, batch 22 wave 1: the six chain rows of Boruto Part 1. ALL SIX STANDINGS CONFIRMED AS STORED (canon), none corrected. Eps 19-23 adapt Kishimoto's ten-chapter Naruto Gaiden 『七代目火影と緋色の花つ月』 complete and in order - 19 = 700+1 + the opening of 700+2, 20 = the rest of 700+2 + 700+3 + 700+4, 21 = 700+5 + 700+6, 22 = 700+7 + 700+8, 23 = 700+9 + 700+10 - every segment SIGNIFICANT under T28, with three restagings recorded as `divergence` under the faithfulness clause and one page-split recorded as `partial` across 19/20. Ep 39 adapts Kishimoto's unnumbered one-shot 『NARUTO外伝 ～満ちた月が照らす道～』 (WSJ 2016 #21/22, collected in Boruto vol 1) in full inside a two-scene present-day frame - frame weight SLIVER, remainder decides, canon. Six `chain_source` annotations delivered in the I41 convention, each starting with the work label; ANCHORS: [] on all six, delivered as anchor_hostile under A44 because the material lives in another chapter space and Boruto's own instrument (chs 1-80) does not begin until ep 53. NO row in the ask also adapts a Boruto-space chapter. Ep 39's 'ch 0' fork resolved in favour of naming the work and refusing the number, with the reasoning and the residual question flagged for Sean. One source conflict adjudicated: animefillerguide's extra 706 on ep 22 refused under R3 on TV Tokyo's own synopsis. No repairs proposed; two suppression/ruling asks flagged.

annotations.note: THE WORK: 『NARUTO -ナルト- 外伝 ～七代目火影と緋色の花つ月～』 (Naruto Gaiden: The Seventh Hokage and the Scarlet Spring), Kishimoto's own ten-chapter mini-series, serialised in Weekly Shonen Jump from the 2015 combined 22/23 issue to issue 32 (27 Apr - 6 Jul 2015) and collected in ONE tankōbon titled 「うちはサラダ」 (Shueisha 2015-08-04, ISBN 978-4-08-880468-2). ja-WP states the shape of the space exactly: 「全700話で、単行本は全72巻と外伝1巻」 - the Gaiden's volume is NOT one of Naruto's 72, and its ten chapters are printed 700+1 … 700+10 (Viz's own citation space: en-WP's article on the mini-series cites it as chapter=700+1, 700+2, 700+3, 700+4 …; Narutopedia's volume page heads the summaries 'Chapter 700+1' … 'Chapter 700+10'). Narutopedia's per-episode field flattens the same ten chapters onto Naruto's running count as 701-710 with volume=73 - that is a WIKI convention, not the printed space; its Semantic-MediaWiki export qualifies every one of these rows with Manga = Naruto (19 -> 701,702; 20 -> 702,703,704; 21 -> 705,706; 22 -> 707,708; 23 -> 709,710; 24 -> 700,705), i.e. the wiki itself says these are NOT Boruto chapters. THE CHAIN (I41, Sean 2026-09-04): Naruto -> Naruto Gaiden -> Boruto; this row sits on the SECOND work, so it is position-less in the entry's instrument (A44) and never carries an anchor. Nothing here touches the Boruto space: Boruto ch 1 opens at the Chūnin Exams and is anchored at ep 53. || SEGMENTS AND WEIGHTS (T28). Segment 1 - ch 700+1 「うちはサラダ」 (Sarada Uchiha): weight: SIGNIFICANT - because it IS this episode's plot, adapted essentially end to end. The chapter's beats in order (Narutopedia's 700+1 summary) and the episode's (Narutopedia ep-19 synopsis) match one for one: the classmates training with their fathers while Sarada has never met hers; Sarada questioning Sakura about Sasuke; Sakura's Cherry Blossom Impact flattening the house and her collapse; Shizune taking her to hospital; Sarada finding the family photo is a crop of the Taka photo with a bespectacled Karin in it. TV Tokyo's official synopsis is the same story (「母のサクラに話を聞いても何も答えてもらえず…父・サスケと写るメガネをかけた若い女性の写真を見たサラダは、ある疑惑に駆られ」). NEW, not a duplicate: nothing of 700+1 has been animated before. Segment 2 - ch 700+2 「写輪眼の少年…!!」 (The Boy with the Sharingan...!!), its OPENING SHARE: weight: SIGNIFICANT - because it is three story-carrying scenes, not a tease: Sarada at the hospital telling Shizune there is no record of her birth in any village hospital; the diner scene where Chōchō doubts her own parents and Mitsuki dismisses it, which is what sends Sarada after Sasuke; and the closing beat of Sasuke stepping out of his portal and being attacked by the hooded boy. NEW here; the REMAINDER of 700+2 (the hawk to Naruto, the Naruto/Kakashi consultation, the boy reporting to his 'father') is adapted by ep 20, so the chapter is page-split across two rows - annotated `partial` there and here. NO BORUTO-SPACE CHAPTER in this row.

THE FAITHFULNESS CLAUSE (T28) - recorded so the row is not read as a page-faithful pass, and it does NOT move the standing. In 700+1 Sarada's walk home shows Boruto 'playing an expansive game of hide-and-seek with his ever-busy father, the Seventh Hokage, coupled with being given a lecture by Shikadai Nara and his father' (Narutopedia's chapter summary). The anime restages that same beat as a different prank: Boruto vandalises the Hokage Rock, Naruto sends a shadow clone that chases him through the village, Sarada misdirects the clone, and Shikamaru pins Boruto with his shadow and lectures him before having Shikadai dispel the clone (Narutopedia ep-19 synopsis; TV Tokyo: 「“火影岩（ほかげいわ）”にイタズラし、父親に追い掛け回されるボルトを見てあきれるサラダ」). Function preserved (Sarada seeing a father who makes time for his child), staging changed - an alteration of the source's own events, which keeps the row CANON. The anime also lets the Academy's graduation framing arrive through Sarada and Chōchō's meal rather than through Shino's classroom announcement, because eps 1-18 have already played the Academy material. weight: NIL toward the type - this is a restaging, not original plot.

Segment 2 - ch 700+6 「進化無き種」 (Unevolving Species): weight: SIGNIFICANT - adapted in full and it is the episode's second half and cliffhanger: the deflected weapons and the Rinnegan swap, the Fire Release with Shin used as a shield, the adult Shin naming himself Uchiha Shin, and the creature warping Sakura away to the base. TV Tokyo's ep-21 synopsis ends on exactly that (「一同は、互いに“うちはシン”と名乗る写輪眼の父子に襲われる！」) and its ep-22 synopsis opens by treating Sakura's abduction as already past (「シンの術によってサクラが連れ去られ、呆然とするサラダ」), which is what settles 700+6 wholly onto THIS row. R3 - a trailing share credited by ONE source only is not carried; 700+6 stays here. DUPLICATE WATCH: 700+5's Kage-summit content is STAGED AGAIN, at length, in ep 24 (Narutopedia's ep-24 field is 700, 705; the stored I41 chain_source on ep 24 says 'Naruto: ch 700; Naruto Gaiden: ch 700+5'). Here it is the chapter's own flashback; there it is the summit played out. This row holds the first-time animation of 700+5's own pages. NO BORUTO-SPACE CHAPTER in this row.

THE FAITHFULNESS CLAUSE (T28) - an alteration of the source's own events, which keeps the row CANON; recorded so the row is not read as page-faithful. In 700+6 the adult Shin turns Sasuke's own sword on Naruto, Naruto's chakra cloak drops, Sasuke shields Sarada with his body and is paralysed by the weapons, Sakura arrives and punches Shin into the ground, and she is caught up in the creature's warp with the two Shins (Narutopedia's 700+6 summary). Narutopedia's ep-21 synopsis gives a shorter, rearranged version: Naruto restrains both Shins with chakra arms, the creature warps the Shins out, then it reaches for Sarada and Sakura pushes her clear and is taken IN HER PLACE. Same outcome (Sakura in Shin's base, the arc's hinge), condensed staging. weight: NIL toward the type. CONFIDENCE: medium on the detail - the evidence is the wiki's episode summary read against the wiki's own chapter summary; TV Tokyo's synopsis states only that 「シンの術によってサクラが連れ去られ」 and does not adjudicate the staging. No source states the episode adds original PLOT here, and none is claimed.

Condensation and re-choreography of the source's own events; no original plot is added and none is claimed by any source. weight: NIL toward the type.

annotations.chapters: Naruto Gaiden: 「満ちた月が照らす道」 (unnumbered one-shot, collected in Boruto vol 1)
annotations.note: THE WORK, and the label used: 『NARUTO -ナルト- 外伝 ～満ちた月が照らす道～』 (Naruto Gaiden: The Path Lit by the Full Moon), a ONE-SHOT written AND drawn by Masashi Kishimoto, published in Weekly Shonen Jump's 2016 combined issue 21/22 (on sale 25 April 2016) - en-WP: 'The monthly series was preceded by a one-shot, titled Naruto: The Path Lit by the Full Moon … written and illustrated by Kishimoto and published on April 25 of that same year' - and later collected in the Boruto manga's volume 1 (Shueisha 2016-08-04, ISBN 978-4-08-880756-0). IT CARRIES NO CHAPTER NUMBER. en-WP's 'List of Boruto chapters' prints volume 1 as a numbered list of THREE chapters (「うずまきボルト!!」, 「修業開始!!」, 「中忍試験開始!!」) followed by the one-shot as an UNNUMBERED extra line - exactly the shape the catalog's 'unnumbered extras and one-shots are FACTS, never numbers' convention describes. Narutopedia's 'Chapter 0' (its chapter page carries chapter=0, boruto=Yes, volume=1; its SMW export gives ep 39 Manga = Boruto, Manga Chapter = 0) is that wiki's slot for 'the thing printed in Boruto vol 1 before ch 1', not a number in the Boruto manga's own space, which runs 1-80 and whose ch 1 is anchored at ep 53. animefillerguide agrees by refusing to give it a number at all: its Chapters cell for ep 39 is the WORK'S TITLE, 'Naruto Gaiden: The Road Illuminated by the Full Moon'. WHY 'Naruto Gaiden' AND NOT 'Boruto': the work's own title is NARUTO外伝, and ja-WP names it that way in the sentence that states what this episode adapts - 「18話からは原作者の岸本斉史が執筆した『NARUTO -ナルト- 外伝〜七代目火影と緋色の花つ月〜』を原作とした「うちはサラダ編」、39話では同じく岸本が執筆した『NARUTO -ナルト- 外伝〜満ちた月が照らす道〜』」. Putting 'Boruto: ch 0' in the field would inject a number into the entry's own instrument space (A44 / N-family) and would read as a Boruto position; naming the Gaiden work and stating that it is unnumbered cannot. THE FORK IS FLAGGED FOR SEAN: I41's 'Naruto Gaiden' node is AniList 86171, i.e. the Scarlet Spring mini-series specifically, and this one-shot is not in that entry - so either the node widens to mean 'Kishimoto's post-Naruto 外伝 works' (two works) or a fourth node is added. Either way the chapters string must NOT become a number. || SEGMENTS AND WEIGHTS (T28). Segment 1 - the one-shot itself: weight: SIGNIFICANT - it is the whole body of the episode, adapted end to end and in order. Narutopedia's chapter summary and its episode synopsis run beat for beat: Mitsuki waking memoryless in Orochimaru's hideout and dropping the cup; Orochimaru telling the hooded figure this is the sixth time; Suigetsu's escort and his sudden test attack, broken by liquefying his arm; Orochimaru introducing himself as Mitsuki's parent and naming Log as the thief of his memories; the barrier, the Temporary Paralysis Technique, the armour that pins Orochimaru and the small snake that poisons Log; Log's mask coming off to reveal an older Mitsuki; both of them synthetic humans; the embryo, the key, Sage Transformation, Mitsuki taking the third option and walking out with both; and the photo of Boruto in the case with Orochimaru's 'if he finds a sun, he can be a moon'. TV Tokyo's official synopsis describes precisely this and nothing else (「ミツキはかつてすべての記憶を奪われ、自分が何者なのか、何をしたいのかもわからないまま、見知らぬ研究所で目覚めたことがあった――。…その中でミツキ自身が選んだこと。」). Segment 2 - the present-day frame (Sarada complaining to Mitsuki about Boruto's lateness and asking whether he ever acts of his own will, which cues the flashback; Boruto arriving at the end and the three leaving on a mission): weight: SLIVER - because it is a two-scene framing device of the anime's own making, it progresses nothing and it exists to justify the flashback's placement between the Graduation Exam and Genin Mission arcs. It is annotated as `divergence` below. The remainder decides the type, and the remainder is the one-shot: CANON. NO BORUTO-SPACE CHAPTER in this row - Narutopedia's 'ch 0' is not one (see above).

annotations.note: TWO anime-side facts, neither of which moves the standing. (1) THE FRAME: the one-shot is told straight through from Mitsuki's waking; the episode wraps it in a present-day conversation between Sarada and Mitsuki about whether he ever acts of his own will, and closes by returning to the present for Boruto's arrival and a mission (Narutopedia ep-39 synopsis; the chapter has neither scene). weight: SLIVER, anime-original, story-carrying share ~nil - a cue and a button around a full adaptation (T28: the remainder decides; canon stands). (2) CENSORSHIP, not adaptation: Narutopedia's Trivia records that in the Japanese TV broadcast and the simulcast, Log's cigarette and left hand were redrawn or edited out of several shots and were restored on the DVD - ja-WP states the same policy series-wide (「奈良シカマルや三途アマドなど、成人でも喫煙描写は原作からカット又は改変されている」). Recorded so a later reader does not mistake a broadcast edit for a story change.

(a) THE PRINTED GAIDEN SPACE is 700+1 ... 700+10 - Viz cites it that way (en-WP's article on the mini-series footnotes chapter=700+1, 700+2, 700+3, 700+4 to the Viz volume) and Narutopedia's own volume page heads its summaries 'Chapter 700+1' ... flags_for_sean: ANCHOR SUPPRESSION SHOULD EXTEND TO THESE ROWS. The context shows ANCHOR_SUPPRESSED (A44) = [24] only. Eps 19, 20, 21, 22, 23 and 39 are the same shape as 24 - content in another work's chapter space, no Boruto-space number to hold - so the suppression list wants [19,20,21,22,23,24,39]. THE ep-39 LABEL FORK, stated as asked. I used the work label 'Naruto Gaiden' and named the one-shot instead of numbering it: chapters = "Naruto Gaiden: 「満ちた月が照らす道」 (unnumbered one-shot, collected in Boruto vol 1)". REASONS: (a) the work's own title is NARUTO外伝 and ja-WP names it that way in the sentence that states what ep 39 adapts; (b) en-WP's Boruto chapter list prints volume 1 as THREE numbered chapters plus this one-shot as an unnumbered extra - it has no number in print; (c) Narutopedia's 'ch 0' (and its SMW Manga = Boruto) is a wiki slot for 'printed in Boruto vol 1', and writing 0 into a chapters field on a Boruto row invites exactly the mis-read A44 forbids; (d) animefillerguide independently refuses the number, printing the work's TITLE in its chapters column. THE COST: I41's 'Naruto Gaiden' node is AniList 86171 = the Scarlet Spring mini-series specifically, and this one-shot is NOT in that entry (AniList has it nowhere as a standalone; it lives inside Boruto vol 1). So the label I used is one work broader than the ruled node. YOUR CALL: (i) widen the node to 'Naruto Gaiden' = Kishimoto's post-Naruto 外伝 works (Scarlet Spring 700+1..700+10 + the Full Moon one-shot), which is what ja-WP's own phrasing does; or (ii) add a fourth node for the one-shot; or (iii) file it under 'Boruto' as the wiki does - which I recommend against, because it would be the only Boruto-labelled chapters string in the catalog with no number in Boruto's space.
